afirmacao.enunciado: O UniProt/Swiss-Prot (Tox-Prot) anota função para Snake venom metalloproteinase batroxrhagin de Bothrops atrox.
afirmacao.passagem: Snake venom metalloproteinase that is highly hemorrhagic (PubMed:26276061, PubMed:28767072). Inhibits collagen-induced platelet-aggregation (PubMed:26276061). Binds with high affinity to extracellular matrix (ECM) proteins (collagen I and collagen IV) and localizes in the basement membrane (BM), since it colocalizes with BM proteins (PubMed:28767072). This binding promotes localized ECM hydrolysis at the injection site despite the enzyme low hydrolytic activity (Probable). Cleaves Xaa-Leu bonds (PubMed:32024243). Hydrolyzes synthetic peptide Abz-AGLA-EDDnp and fibrin, and shows weak hydrolyzis activity on collagen and laminin (PubMed:26276061, PubMed:28767072, PubMed:32024243). Does not bind to laminin and nidogen (PubMed:28767072). In vivo, does not induce tissue necrosis at the injected region, presenting only a few regions of epidermis loss and inflammatory infiltrate concentrated in the hypodermis (PubMed:28767072). Is involved in the inflammatory reaction observed in B.atrox envenomation (PubMed:32024243). Acts by direct action on inflammatory cells, including induction of inflammatory mediator release and by releasing pro-inflammatory peptides from BM proteins (PubMed:32024243)
